training_cap.user_instruction: Thêm tối đa 2 lượt training nữa, nếu không cải thiện thì dừng lại
training_cap.scope: global across all workers; overrides open-ended training
training_cap.count_rule: consume on optimizer start including failed or partial attempts; no automatic retries
training_cap.release_rule: independent evidence and explicit coordinator release required per attempt; stop early on no meaningful improvement
training_cap.stop_reason: Hard early stop: classifier-only failed accuracy and contrast separation CAL gates; no Attempt 2 authorized.
